record: scene record — phase 4 (visual storytelling). The scene was authored fresh for this branch from the phase-2 architecture and style decision. Per-compartment origin: every compartment below is designed-then-built; NO code, asset or layout was adapted from the first build's scene — the only evidence consulted before building was the render/QA tooling contract (a seek-driven page: window.__seek + PLAN), which is production infrastructure, not design. The engine pattern (deterministic renderAt(t), per-line word layers, in-scene edit overlay) follows the soa-01 causal rebuild's proven pattern, re-implemented for this piece's choreography (keyframed card flights implement the continuity law).

elements.decision: Dark radial void (#05060a to #10131f), A59 grammar trait 1; holds every compartment without competing with it.

EARTH ONE · WORD DEFINITIONS — the lane furniture, small caps at the top, present throughout so any frame names its series (sound-off orientation). The wording is the inherited lane convention (register R-6).

ONE card is the scene's spine object under the continuity law prescribed in phase 2: it enters as the chat card (C1), is re-tagged the first direction (C2), flies onto the work-page as its first direction (C3), rides over the context stream (C4), stacks in the pile (C5) and is gathered into the mega prompt (C6). Same DOM element throughout — its identity is never re-drawn.

Skeleton text bars while L1 speaks (a sentence being typed, not yet words); at the spoken example (L3 'build', 9.78 s) the face resolves to the typed line 'build me a page' — said = shown at the word.

The flat picture drawn: a tag under the card reading THE PROMPT, appearing at the word 'prompt' (1.34 s). At 'not.' (5.50 s) a strike bar crosses it; at 'direction' (6.44 s) it is replaced by the gold tag FIRST DIRECTION. This is where Candidate A's spoken question migrated (consolidation §4/S1): the picture is judged and re-tagged, visually.
A gold arrow draws itself out of the card at 'direction' (6.44–7.15 s): the concept's first visual — a prompt POINTS. It retires when the card flies to the page.

The page being built: a bordered frame that enters at 'page.' (10.37 s) and receives the directions. At 'warmer.' its border warms and glows; at 'Shorter.' its header bar shortens (element page-header-bar); the third steering card is itself the 'for my mother' change. The steering is shown changing the work, not just arriving.
'THE PAGE BEING BUILT' inside the page's clear zone, so the container is named sound-off. (Re-sited in QA round 1 — see qa log.)
The page's header bar: full width until 'Shorter.' (16.01 s), then shortened by 190 px — the page visibly obeys the steering it receives.
Steering card 1: lands in the page at 'warmer.' (15.59 s). Same element rides to the stream row (C4), the pile (C5) and the gathering (C6).
Steering card 2: lands at 'Shorter.' (16.01 s); same continuity path as card 1.
Steering card 3: 'FOR MY MOTHER' lands at 'For' (16.88 s) — the audience-steering the audience field (phase 1) names; same continuity path.

A ribbon of ten blocks along the lower frame: blocks extend as the context is produced and continued (L5 words), squeeze denser at 'compacting' (23.36 s), and step downward in a visible bend after 'bends' (25.57 s) — produced, continued, compacted, bent, never re-drawn. It dims (never vanishes) under the accumulation and retires at the payoff.
'THE CONTEXT — PRODUCED, CONTINUED, COMPACTED' above the ribbon at 'context' (22.00 s): the mechanism is named on screen so M4 survives sound-off reading.
'FOUR DIRECTIONS — AND COUNTING' appears over the pile at 'accumulates' (31.71 s): the count is SHOWN by the stack and stated by the counter — the transcript never counts aloud (consolidation §4/S4).
First dashed outline card behind the pile at 'direction' (32.52 s): the pile is still growing — accumulation is open-ended, not a closed set of four.
Second dashed outline at 'direction,' (33.41 s), fainter and higher: the rhythm of 'direction after direction' drawn.
A gold spine draws down the pile's left edge at 'chain' (38.86–39.70 s): the session's directions are BOUND into one object before the gathering is shown. (Re-formed in QA round 2 — see qa log.)

The gathering as one bordered card entering at 'mega' (41.82 s) at cinematic scale: the stack's members are inside it as its summary rows — the mega prompt is the same directions, chained. It recedes (up, smaller, dimmed) at the payoff so the definition restates over it, never colliding with it.
'MEGA PROMPT' at 88 px gold serif — one of the two moments phase 2 rations cinematic type to (the gathering); type's job is verdict weight.

The four directions as rows inside the mega card — BUILD ME A PAGE / WARMER / SHORTER / FOR MY MOTHER: the chain summary's contents, identical to the cards the viewer watched accumulate (continuity to the last element).
L8 set as hero type below the receded mega card — the second rationed cinematic moment (phase 2): the definition restates at verdict size, with 'directions' monumental gold (104 px).
'NEXT — the thing being steered all along / WHAT IS CONTEXT? →' in the tail over bed only (phase-2 end_referral): the referral to WD-04, silent, held for the 2.00 s tail.

Per-line layers carry the spoken words in the lower safe zone; principal words gold and enlarged. The band is word animation (each word enters at its spoken instant from the PLAN), never a subtitle block: words appear WITH the voice and clear per line. L5's layer is set smaller (45 px) so the mechanism line's 21 words stay inside the band.

The ?edit=1 inspector: click any word to read its decision record and adjust its timing/offset/scale (localStorage overlay 'wd02-edit'); the scene remains an editable file system, not a baked picture. Proof executed at phase 7.

sound_off: the full story reads from the frames alone: a lone card tagged THE PROMPT; the tag struck and re-tagged FIRST DIRECTION with an arrow; the card and three steering cards landing on a page that warms and shortens; a labelled context ribbon extending, compacting and bending; the four cards stacked under 'FOUR DIRECTIONS — AND COUNTING'; a gold spine chaining the stack; the MEGA PROMPT card holding the same four directions as its summary; the definition restated at verdict size; the bridge to WHAT IS CONTEXT?
